description: Hyperliquid venue-wide hourly series, newest hour first, by `view`. `ecosystem`: perp equity, open interest and position counts per hour. `volume`: traded perp notional per hour, of the whole venue (builder-DEX perps included; spot and outcome markets left out) or of one `symbol`: `volume` counts each trade ONCE (one side), the figure the candles report, while `n_fills` counts fill records, two per trade. Money is USD. Keyset-paged with `cursor`. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/stats and /stats/volume.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page.

limit.description: Hourly rows per page, newest first. Max 5000.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. `volume` only; omit for the whole venue (perps, builder-DEX perps included; spot and outcome markets are left out). Used by view: volume.

view.description: What to read. `ecosystem`: hourly venue-wide perp equity, open interest and position counts, newest first. `volume`: hourly perp volume of the whole venue or one symbol, newest first. Default `ecosystem`.

name: hl_stats
title: Hyperliquid Stats
